verdict.rationale: Choosing a model is a fair question for an agent-orchestration and review platform like Foreloop, so the axis applies. The evidence never mentions automatic model selection or a setting to pin a specific model. Users run their own agent (Claude Code or Codex) on their own machine, but that is a user-side arrangement, not a Foreloop model-selection control.

support.subject: As an engineering-lead, I can switch away from automatic model selection to a specific model of my choice
